title: Lysistrata
author: Aristophanes
current_text: In 1967, the military clique ruling Greece banned Lysistrata in Athens, presumably because of its independent and antiwar themes.

sources.quote: 1967 Greece-Athens: The military clique then ruling the country banned a number of classic plays, Lysistrata, presumably because of their independent and antiwar themes
sources.title: Lysistrata - Censorpedia

ban_rows.note: A copy consigned to a Beverly Hills book dealer was intercepted by the U.S. Post Office as obscene and returned only after suit (aided by the ACLU). Year approximate.
